rationale: Third-party child suffered bodily injury (broken wrist) due to icy condition of policyholder's premises, a classic liability scenario.
claim_summary: Neighbor's nine-year-old daughter slipped and fell on policyholder's icy walkway during ice storm last week, sustaining a broken wrist. Parents are pursuing medical bills. High-severity pediatric injury claim under homeowners liability coverage with $500k limit.

case_facts.location: walkway in front of policyholder's house
case_facts.description: ice storm caused icy walkway conditions
case_facts.claim_basis: third party injury from premises condition
